fixes: HiRadixCache and UnifiedRadixCache load-back readiness predicates no longer enter loading_check collectives behind rank-local CUDA event queries. The unconditional scheduler HiCache pump still retires acks.
PDMux bypasses FlashInfer all-reduce fusion workspaces shared across prefill/decode lanes. Ordinary lane-specific TP communication and CPU overlap remain enabled.
FlashInfer workspace reuse requires matching communication groups and rank, as well as world size and capacity. This includes the legacy rendezvous-group argument.

pdmux_qwen_split_scheduler.note: Run before the final legacy-group test was added; production sources unchanged afterward.

cuda_regression.skip_reason: Two distinct CUDA GPUs are required for the TP2 NCCL check.

test_fixture_repairs: The PP event-pump fixture now declares its write-through policy.
The tiny HiRadixCache GPU fixture excludes the production 10-GiB reserve while still checking actual available RAM.
test_environment_repairs: Added the existing virtualenv Ninja and CUDA compiler directories to PATH for native cache tests.
Downloaded and unpacked Ubuntu OpenSSL development headers under the isolated validation directory; no system package installation.
limitations: One GPU cannot validate two-GPU NCCL progress or the original 4219-request SWE workload.
FlashInfer fusion contract tests mock collectives; native SM90/SM10X fusion performance was not measured on the SM89 4060.
The HiCache local polling bug belongs to the decode restore path and is not asserted to be the cause of the original PDMux timeout.
PDMux intentionally falls back from the shared FlashInfer all-reduce fusion fast path; throughput on the deployment host must be remeasured.
